hypothesis: The existing frozen selector may improve mandatory unordered single-card choices relative to first-baseline's PPO actor. Previous 18-14 results on 16 seed pairs were exploratory and did not demonstrate improvement.

candidate.controlledChange: Only AgentBundle.route singleton becomes ranking. Ordinary actions, all other prompt routes, history, validation, helper and both checkpoints stay frozen.

comparison.pilotDeck: Frozen AgentPult scenario from first-baseline environment
comparison.referencePolicyReason: Stable anchor, existing rules teacher and compatible archived learned policy provide different behaviors. The archived policy is not claimed stronger.
comparison.opponentDecks: This first routing experiment preserves the existing mirrored deck scenario. The separately authorized varied Limitless opponent-deck pool follows exact-list support qualification and gets its own fixed schedule; it is not silently mixed into this protocol.
comparison.independentUnit: One independently generated opening-seed block. Candidate and incumbent share each nonbaseline opponent seed and exchange seats. Seats and decisions are not independent units.
comparison.baselineControl: Identical deterministic first-baseline self-play has paired score exactly 0.5 under seat exchange and zero-sum outcomes. Candidate-baseline blocks subtract this constant; no self-play simulation is needed.
comparison.seedNamespace: tcg-agent/model6-hillclimb-001/development/v1; SHA256 namespace:index first uint32, reject collisions with prior campaign manifests

analysis.primary: Fixed-mixture mean of candidate minus incumbent paired score; 1600 independent blocks, ranges width 1 for 800 anchor blocks and width 2 for 800 shared-opponent contrast blocks.
analysis.interval: Two-sided bounded-variable Hoeffding with Bonferroni allocation to four predeclared endpoints; retain pairing in matchup differences.
analysis.decisionRelevantEffect: 10 percentage-point mixture advantage; large 30-point matchup shifts for specialist endpoints
analysis.sampleJustification: Mixture interval radius about 0.063; Hoeffding lower-tail bound gives at least 82% power for a true +0.10 advantage to clear zero. Matchup contrasts are explicitly less precise.
analysis.candidateGate: Mixture lower bound >0 AND direct-anchor lower bound >0; then independent fresh confirmation is required before promotion. A supported matchup specialist can enter the population without replacing the champion.
analysis.stopping: Fixed endpoints, no win-based stopping, extension or tuning. Engineering failures preserve raw evidence and require an explicit recovery amendment; incomplete samples cannot pass the gate.

compute.nativeQualification: Existing state-copy parity qualification; scenario remains byte-identical. No search or belief-scope change in this candidate.
compute.scheduling: Queue new gameplay until Model7 final confirmation finishes and is preserved. Do not change that campaign, use its seeds, or consume its partial outcomes for candidate selection. Source/math tests may run before capacity is released.

next: Use observed controlled routing evidence and the frozen search-on/off diagnostic to choose subsequent small variants. Retain useful specialists. Distill only a demonstrated stronger teacher and independently test the student.
